89/**
90 * Initialize the render loop with GPU state and dataset
91 * @param {Object} initialGpuState - WebGPU state object
92 * @param {Object} initialDataset - Dataset with bricks and header
93 */
94export function initRenderLoop(initialGpuState, initialDataset) {
95 state.gpuState = initialGpuState;
96 state.dataset = initialDataset;
97
98 if (!state.dataset.hiddenLabels) {
99 state.dataset.hiddenLabels = new Set();
100 }
101 state.cameraController = initialGpuState.cameraController ?? null;
102
103 // Calculate max LOD based on brick size
104 // At LOD k, voxel count = brickSize / 2^k
105 // Max useful LOD is when we reach 1 voxel: brickSize / 2^maxLOD = 1
106 // Therefore: maxLOD = log2(brickSize)
107 state.maxLOD = Math.floor(Math.log2(state.dataset.header.brickSize));
108
109 // Initialize GPU timing infrastructure (3 timestamps: decode start/end, raytrace end)
110 const device = initialGpuState.device;
111 const hasTimestamps = device.features.has('chromium-experimental-timestamp-query-inside-passes');
112 console.log(`GPU timestamp queries: ${hasTimestamps ? 'SUPPORTED ✓' : 'NOT SUPPORTED (timing will show --)'}`);
113
114 state.querySet = device.createQuerySet({
115 type: 'timestamp',
116 count: 3
117 });
118 state.stagingBuffer = device.createBuffer({
119 size: 24, // 3 timestamps × 8 bytes each
120 usage: GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST | GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ
121 });
122
123 // Initialize cache and work queue with pre-calculated LODs from webgpuSetup
124 initializeCache(initialGpuState.initialBrickLODs);
125
126 // Start the frame loop
127 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
128}

130/**
131 * Initialize cache with visible bricks
132 * @param {Array<number>} initialLODs - Pre-calculated LOD array
133 */
134function initializeCache(initialLODs) {
135 // On first frame, allocate ALL bricks regardless of visibility
136 // This ensures the full dataset is immediately available when camera moves
137 // After first frame, subsequent updates use normal frustum culling
138 const forceAll = true; // Always force all bricks on initialization
139
140 // Use the calculated LODs, not forced full resolution
141 const result = initCacheInternal(
142 state.gpuState,
143 state.dataset,
144 initialLODs,
145 state.dataset.header.brickSize,
146 forceAll
147 );
148
149 const { allocatedBricks } = result;
150
151 // Ensure pooled buffers are allocated before filling work queues
152 state.bufferManager.ensureBufferPools(state.dataset.bricks.length, allocatedBricks.length);
153
154 // Prepare and write buffers for initial frame
155 const { data: dynamicBrickData } = updateBrickInfoBuffer({
156 lodArray: initialLODs,
157 allocatedBricks,
158 cache: state.gpuState.brickCache,
159 dataset: state.dataset,
160 brickSize: state.dataset.header.brickSize
161 });
162
163 const { workQueue, workCount, count } = updateWorkQueue({
164 allocatedBricks,
165 workQueuePool: state.bufferManager.workQueuePool,
166 workCountBuffer: state.bufferManager.workCountBuffer
167 });
168
169 // Ensure the CPU-side count is set so the first compute pass dispatches
170 state.gpuState.workCount = count;
171
172 // Batch GPU writes for initialization
173 const device = state.gpuState.device;
174 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.dynamicBricksBuffer, 0, dynamicBrickData);
175 if (workQueue) {
176 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.workQueueBuffer, 0, workQueue);
177 }
178 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.workCountBuffer, 0, new Uint32Array([count]));
179
180 state.lastAllocatedBrickCount = allocatedBricks.length;
181}

186function updateCameraUniformIfNeeded() {
187 if (!state.gpuState.camera || !state.gpuState.cameraUniformBuffer) return;
188
189 // If controller reports a pending upload, ensure camera uniforms update before GPU work
190 const needsUpload = (state.cameraController && state.cameraController.needsUpload()) ||
191 state.gpuState.camera.needsUpload?.();
192 if (!needsUpload) return;
193
194 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(

197 state.gpuState.camera.getUniformData()
198 );

200 if (state.cameraController && state.cameraController.markUploaded) {

204 }

207// ==================== Core Frame Loop ====================
208
209/**
210 * Main render loop frame function
211 */
212function frame() {
213 // Performance tracking
214 const currentTime = performance.now();
215 const frameTime = currentTime - state.lastFrameTime;
216 state.lastFrameTime = currentTime;
217
218 state.frameTimes.push(frameTime);
219 if (state.frameTimes.length > RENDER_CONFIG.FRAME_SAMPLE_COUNT) {
220 state.frameTimes.shift();
221 }
222
223 const hasTimestampFeature = state.gpuState.device.features.has('chromium-experimental-timestamp-query-inside-passes');
224
225 // Update performance display every N frames
226 if (state.frameTimes.length % RENDER_CONFIG.PERF_UPDATE_INTERVAL === 0) {
227 const decodeElem = document.getElementById('perf-decode');
228 const raytraceElem = document.getElementById('perf-raytrace');
229 const overallElem = document.getElementById('perf-overall');
230
231 if (hasTimestampFeature) {
232 if (decodeElem) decodeElem.textContent = `Decode ${state.gpuTimings.decode.toFixed(2)} ms`;
233 if (raytraceElem) raytraceElem.textContent = `Raytrace ${state.gpuTimings.raytrace.toFixed(2)} ms`;
234 if (overallElem) overallElem.textContent = `Overall ${state.gpuTimings.overall.toFixed(2)} ms`;
235 } else {
236 if (decodeElem) decodeElem.textContent = `Decode --`;
237 if (raytraceElem) raytraceElem.textContent = `Raytrace --`;
238 if (overallElem) overallElem.textContent = `Overall --`;
239 }
240 }
241
242 updateCameraUniformIfNeeded();
243
244 // Skip frame if request readback buffers are currently mapped
245 if (state.isRequestReadbackMapped) {
246 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
247 return;
248 }
249
250 // Only recalculate LODs periodically AND when camera has moved
251 state.framesSinceLastLODUpdate++;
252 if (state.framesSinceLastLODUpdate >= RENDER_CONFIG.LOD_UPDATE_INTERVAL &&
253 !state.lodUpdateInProgress &&
254 cameraHasMoved()) {
255 state.framesSinceLastLODUpdate = 0;
256 updateBrickLODs();
257 }
258
259 // Pre-submission: Clear brick request buffer BEFORE creating encoder
260 // This must happen in GPU order before ray marching writes to it
261 if (state.gpuState.brickRequestBuffer && state.dataset.bricks.length > 0) {
262 const clearValue = new Uint32Array(state.dataset.bricks.length).fill(0); // 0 = not accessed
263 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.brickRequestBuffer, 0, clearValue);
264 }
265
266 const encoder = state.gpuState.device.createCommandEncoder();
267
268 // GPU timestamp 0: decode start (if feature available)
269 if (hasTimestampFeature) {
270 let tsPass = encoder.beginComputePass();
271 tsPass.writeTimestamp(state.querySet, 0);
272 tsPass.end();
273 }
274
275 // Run compute pass to decode bricks
276 runComputePass(encoder, state.gpuState);
277
278 // GPU timestamp 1: decode end / raytrace start
279 if (hasTimestampFeature) {
280 let tsPass = encoder.beginComputePass();
281 tsPass.writeTimestamp(state.querySet, 1);
282 tsPass.end();
283 }
284
285 // CRITICAL: Clear ray trace output buffer using compute shader
286 // This prevents stale pixel data artifacts when voxels become transparent (hidden labels)
287 // Using a compute shader ensures proper synchronization and complete clearing
288 runClearRayOutputPass(encoder, state.gpuState);
289
290 // Run ray tracing pass
291 runRayTracePass(encoder, state.gpuState);
292
293 // GPU timestamp 2: raytrace end / overall end
294 if (hasTimestampFeature) {
295 let tsPass = encoder.beginComputePass();
296 tsPass.writeTimestamp(state.querySet, 2);
297 tsPass.end();
298 }
299
300 // Run display pass to show results on canvas
301 runDisplayPass(encoder, state.gpuState);
302
303 // Copy GPU request buffer for readback (track which bricks were accessed)
304 if (state.gpuState.brickRequestBuffer && state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback && !state.isRequestReadbackMapped) {
305 encoder.copyBufferToBuffer(
306 state.gpuState.brickRequestBuffer,
307 0,
308 state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback,
309 0,
310 state.dataset.bricks.length * 4
311 );
312 }
313
314 // Copy timestamp results to staging buffer for readback (only if feature is available)
315 if (hasTimestampFeature) {
316 encoder.copyQuerySetResultsToBuffer(state.querySet, 0, 3, state.stagingBuffer, 0);
317 }
318
319 state.gpuState.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
320 // Readback GPU timestamps asynchronously (only if feature is available)
321 if (hasTimestampFeature && !state.isGPUResultsMapped) {
322 state.isGPUResultsMapped = true;
323 state.stagingBuffer.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ).then(() => {
324 const mapped = state.stagingBuffer.getMappedRange();
325 const timestamps = new BigUint64Array(mapped);
326 const ts0 = Number(timestamps[0]); // decode start
327 const ts1 = Number(timestamps[1]); // decode end / raytrace start
328 const ts2 = Number(timestamps[2]); // raytrace end
329
330 state.gpuTimings.decode = (ts1 - ts0) / 1_000_000; // ns to ms
331 state.gpuTimings.raytrace = (ts2 - ts1) / 1_000_000; // ns to ms
332 state.gpuTimings.overall = (ts2 - ts0) / 1_000_000; // ns to ms
333
334 state.stagingBuffer.unmap();
335 state.isGPUResultsMapped = false;
336 }).catch((err) => {
337 console.error('GPU timestamp readback failed:', err);
338 state.isGPUResultsMapped = false;
339 });
340 }
341
342 // Process GPU request readback asynchronously (non-blocking)
343 if (state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback && !state.isRequestReadbackMapped) {
344 state.isRequestReadbackMapped = true;
345 state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ).then(() => {
346 const mapped = state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback.getMappedRange();
347 // Copy data out before unmapping
348 state.pendingGPURequests = new Uint32Array(mapped).slice();
349 state.gpuState.brickRequestReadback.unmap();
350 state.isRequestReadbackMapped = false;
351 state.gpuRequestsReady = true; // Signal that new requests are available
352 }).catch((err) => {
353 console.error('Error during GPU request readback:', err);
354 state.isRequestReadbackMapped = false;
355 });
356 }
357
358 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
359}

361// ==================== LOD Management & Cache Processing ====================

363/**
364 * Update brick LODs based on camera position
365 */
366function updateBrickLODs() {
367 const { calculateAllBrickLODs, device, brickCache, canvas } = state.gpuState;
368
369 if (!state.gpuState.camera || !brickCache) return;
370
371 state.lodUpdateInProgress = true;
372
373 // Recalculate LODs based on current camera position (async with Workers)
374 calculateAllBrickLODs(
375 state.dataset.bricks,
376 state.gpuState.camera,
377 Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height), // Use smaller dimension for conservative LOD
378 state.maxLOD,
379 state.dataset.header.brickSize
380 ).then((result) => {
381 const { lodArray, offsetArray } = result;
382
383 // Cache management pipeline
384 processCachePipeline(lodArray, offsetArray);
385 }).catch((err) => {
386 console.error("Error calculating brick LODs:", err);
387 }).finally(() => {
388 state.lodUpdateInProgress = false;
389 });
390}

392/**
393 * Process cache based on LOD calculations
394 * @param {Array<number>} lodArray - LOD values for all bricks
395 * @param {Array<number>} offsetArray - Offset values
396 */
397function processCachePipeline(lodArray, offsetArray) {
398 const { allocatedBricks, evictedCount, stats, candidateBricks } = processCache({
399 lodArray,
400 offsetArray,
401 gpuState: state.gpuState,
402 dataset: state.dataset,
403 pendingGPURequests: state.pendingGPURequests,
404 gpuRequestsReady: state.gpuRequestsReady
405 });
406
407 // Clear GPU requests flag after processing
408 if (state.gpuRequestsReady) {
409 state.gpuRequestsReady = false;
410 }
411
412 // --- Improved Patch: Track and clear both old and new output buffer offsets for bricks whose cache position changes ---
413 const brickCount = state.dataset.bricks.length;
414 const brickSize = state.dataset.header.brickSize;
415 const voxelsPerBrick = Math.pow(brickSize, 3);
416 const device = state.gpuState.device;
417 const outVoxelBuffer = state.gpuState.outVoxelBuffer;
418
419 // Track previous offsets for each brick
420 if (!state._prevBrickOffsets) {
421 state._prevBrickOffsets = new Array(brickCount).fill(0xFFFFFFFF);
422 }
423
424 // Initialize tracking arrays
425 if (!state._prevBrickOffsets) {
426 state._prevBrickOffsets = new Array(brickCount).fill(0xFFFFFFFF);
427 }
428 if (!state._prevBrickLods) {
429 state._prevBrickLods = new Array(brickCount).fill(-1);
430 }
431
432 // Update previous tracking for next frame
433 for (let i = 0; i < brickCount; i++) {
434 const brick = state.dataset.bricks[i];
435 const currOffset = brick.outputOffset;
436 const currCacheInfo = state.gpuState.brickCache.getCacheInfo(i);
437
438 state._prevBrickOffsets[i] = currOffset;
439 state._prevBrickLods[i] = currCacheInfo ? currCacheInfo.lod : -1;
440 }
441
442 // Always refresh dynamic brick info buffer to avoid stale offsets after reallocations/LOD changes
443 state.bufferManager.ensureBufferPools(
444 state.dataset.bricks.length,
445 allocatedBricks.length
446 );
447
448 const { data: dynamicBrickData } = updateBrickInfoBuffer({
449 lodArray,
450 allocatedBricks,
451 cache: state.gpuState.brickCache,
452 dataset: state.dataset,
453 brickSize: state.dataset.header.brickSize
454 });
455
456 const { workQueue, workCount, count } = updateWorkQueue({
457 allocatedBricks,
458 workQueuePool: state.bufferManager.workQueuePool,
459 workCountBuffer: state.bufferManager.workCountBuffer
460 });
461
462 // Batch all GPU writes together for efficiency
463 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.dynamicBricksBuffer, 0, dynamicBrickData);
464
465 if (workQueue) {
466 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.workQueueBuffer, 0, workQueue);
467 }
468 device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.workCountBuffer, 0, new Uint32Array([count]));
469
470 state.gpuState.workCount = count;
471 state.lastAllocatedBrickCount = allocatedBricks.length;
472}

499/**
500 * Force a full brick cache refresh and reload
501 */
502export function forceFullBrickRefresh() {
503 if (!state.gpuState || !state.gpuState.brickCache) return;
504
505 state.gpuState.brickCache.rebuild();
506 state.gpuState.workCount = 0;
507 state.reset();
508
509 // Invalidate dynamic brick info so stale cached offsets are not used
510 if (state.gpuState.dynamicBricksBuffer && state.dataset?.bricks?.length) {
511 const stride = 4;
512 const invalid = new Uint32Array(state.dataset.bricks.length * stride);
513 for (let i = 0; i < state.dataset.bricks.length; i++) {
514 const base = i * stride;
515 invalid[base + 0] = 0xFFFFFFFF; // mark as not cached
516 invalid[base + 1] = 0;
517 invalid[base + 2] = 0;
518 invalid[base + 3] = 0;
519 }
520 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.dynamicBricksBuffer, 0, invalid);
521 }
522
523 // CRITICAL: Write EMPTY_VALUE (0xFFFFFFFF) to entire voxel buffer
524 // This ensures hidden labels are truly gone, not just zeroed
525 if (state.gpuState.outVoxelBuffer && Number.isFinite(state.gpuState.voxelBufferSize)) {
526 const voxelCount = state.gpuState.voxelBufferSize / 4; // u32 elements
527 const EMPTY_VALUE = 0xFFFFFFFF;
528
529 // Write in chunks to avoid memory issues
530 const chunkSize = 256 * 1024; // 1MB chunks (256K u32 values)
531 for (let offset = 0; offset < voxelCount; offset += chunkSize) {
532 const count = Math.min(chunkSize, voxelCount - offset);
533 const chunk = new Uint32Array(count).fill(EMPTY_VALUE);
534 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(
535 state.gpuState.outVoxelBuffer,
536 offset * 4,
537 chunk
538 );
539 }
540 }
541
542 // Clear GPU work counter
543 if (state.gpuState.workCountBuffer) {
544 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(state.gpuState.workCountBuffer, 0, new Uint32Array([0]));
545 }
546}

548/**
549 * Re-decode all currently cached bricks using the latest transfer function/colors
550 */
551export function reDecodeCachedBricks() {
552 if (!state.gpuState || !state.gpuState.brickCache) return;
553
554 const cachedIndices = Array.from(state.gpuState.brickCache.residency.keys());
555 if (cachedIndices.length === 0) return;
556
557 cachedIndices.sort((a, b) => a - b);
558
559 state.bufferManager.ensureBufferPools(state.dataset.bricks.length, cachedIndices.length);
560 for (let i = 0; i < cachedIndices.length; i++) {
561 state.bufferManager.workQueuePool[i] = cachedIndices[i];
562 }
563
564 state.bufferManager.workCountBuffer[0] = cachedIndices.length;
565 state.gpuState.workCount = cachedIndices.length;
566
567 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(
568 state.gpuState.workQueueBuffer,
569 0,
570 state.bufferManager.workQueuePool,
571 0,
572 cachedIndices.length
573 );
574 state.gpuState.device.queue.writeBuffer(
575 state.gpuState.workCountBuffer,
576 0,
577 state.bufferManager.workCountBuffer
578 );
579}
